description: Sid Meier's Civilization IV: The Complete Edition (Firaxis 2005, GOG build 2.0.0.4, via Proton)
long: Sid Meier's Civilization IV is a 2005 turn-based 4X strategy game in which players build and guide a civilization from antiquity into the future. It introduced religion, great people, and a refined culture system to the long-running series. The Complete Edition bundles the base game with its expansions, supporting both single-player and multiplayer.
